method.ccu: players online at collection time; daily figures average every sample that day
method.funnel: badges by share of players who earned them (top badge = 100%)
method.growth: today's average players online versus the same figure 1, 7 and 28 days ago
method.newPlayersPerDay: largest past-day award among early badges; a floor, not exact
method.revenueEstimate: ESTIMATE ONLY: daily player-hours times Roblox's platform-average bookings and developer-exchange per engagement hour (Q2 2026), shown as a 0.5x-2.0x band. Real games vary far more than this.
